camel_example: aliyun dms ListAgenticSecurityPolicies --region cn-hangzhou --IncludeArchived true --Size 20 --PolicyStatus ON --Page 1 --version 2025-04-14 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the user security policy of the current Alibaba Cloud account by page and returns the enabled system default security policy
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号的用户安全策略，并返回启用的系统默认安全策略
kebab_example: aliyun dms list-agentic-security-policies --policy-status ON --include-archived true --page 1 --size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgenticSecurityPolicies

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for the user policy status. Valid values: ON (enabled) and OFF (disabled). If this parameter is not specified or contains only whitespace characters, policies are not filtered by status. You cannot specify ARCHIVED. To query archived user policies, do not specify this parameter and set IncludeArchived to true. This parameter does not affect system default policies
parameters.help_zh: 用户策略状态筛选条件。支持 ON（启用）和 OFF（停用）。不传或仅包含空白字符时，不按状态筛选。不能传入 ARCHIVED；如需查询已归档用户策略，请不传本参数并将 IncludeArchived 设为 true。本参数不影响系统默认策略
parameters.name: policy_status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include archived policies in the query scope of user policies. Valid values:
true: Includes archived policies.
false: Does not include archived policies.
Default value: false. When querying archived policies, do not specify PolicyStatus. If ON or OFF is specified, only user policies in the corresponding state are returned. This parameter does not affect system default policies
parameters.help_zh: 是否在用户策略查询范围内包含已归档策略。true：包含；false：不包含。默认值为 false。查询归档策略时应不传 PolicyStatus；若指定 ON 或 OFF，仍仅返回相应状态的用户策略。本参数不影响系统默认策略
parameters.name: include_archived

parameters.help_en: The page number of the user policies to query. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1. Only user policies are paginated. System default policies are returned separately in each call
parameters.help_zh: 用户策略的查询页码，从 1 开始，默认值为 1。仅对用户策略分页，系统默认策略会在每次调用时另行返回
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of user policies to query on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. In addition, each call returns up to Size enabled system default policies. Therefore, the number of items in the returned Data may be greater than Size
parameters.help_zh: 每页查询的用户策略条数，取值范围为 1～100，默认值为 20。此外，每次调用还会返回最多 Size 条启用的系统默认策略，因此返回的 Data 条目数可能大于 Size
parameters.name: size

schema.description_en: The query result of the security policy list
schema.description_zh: 安全策略列表查询结果

Data.description_en: The list of security policies returned by this query. Enabled system default policies are placed at the beginning, followed by the user policies on the current page. You can use Readonly to distinguish between the two types of policies
Data.description_zh: 本次查询返回的安全策略列表。启用的系统默认策略位于前部，后接当前页的用户策略；可通过 Readonly 区分两类策略

AliyunAccountUid.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the user policy belongs. This value is not returned for system default policies
AliyunAccountUid.description_zh: 用户策略所属的阿里云主账号 UID。系统默认策略不返回此值

BasePolicyId.description_en: The ID of the system default policy inherited by the user policy. This value is empty if no inheritance relationship is configured. This value is not returned for system default policies
BasePolicyId.description_zh: 用户策略继承的系统默认策略 ID。未配置继承关系时为空；系统默认策略不返回此值

Description.description_en: The description of the security policy. The description of a system default policy is returned in the language of the request context
Description.description_zh: 安全策略的描述。系统默认策略的描述按调用上下文的语言返回

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the security policy was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format and does not contain a time zone offset
GmtCreate.description_zh: 安全策略的创建时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，返回值不包含时区偏移

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the security policy was last modified. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format and does not contain a time zone offset
GmtModified.description_zh: 安全策略的最近修改时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，返回值不包含时区偏移

PolicyId.description_en: The business ID of the security policy. A system default policy ID starts with sp-sys-, and a user policy ID starts with sp-usr-
PolicyId.description_zh: 安全策略的业务 ID。系统默认策略 ID 以 sp-sys- 开头，用户策略 ID 以 sp-usr- 开头

PolicyName.description_en: The Policy Name of the security policy. The Policy Name of a system default policy is returned in the language of the request context
PolicyName.description_zh: 安全策略名称。系统默认策略的名称按调用上下文的语言返回

PolicyStatus.description_en:
The current state of the security policy. Valid values:
ON: Enabled.
OFF: Disabled.
ARCHIVED: Archived.
All system default policies returned by this operation are in the ON state
PolicyStatus.description_zh: 安全策略的当前状态。ON：启用；OFF：停用；ARCHIVED：已归档。本接口返回的系统默认策略均为 ON

Readonly.description_en:
Specifies whether the policy is read-only. Valid values:
true: The policy is a system default policy.
false: The policy is a user policy of the current account
Readonly.description_zh: 策略是否只读。true：系统默认策略；false：当前账号的用户策略

Tags.description_en: The tags of the system default policy. Multiple tags are separated by commas (,). This value is not returned for user policies
Tags.description_zh: 系统默认策略的标签，多个标签以英文逗号（,）分隔。用户策略不返回此值

UpdatedBy.description_en: The identifier of the operator that last modified the policy. For a user policy, the operator ID is recorded first. If no operator ID is available, the UID of the current Alibaba Cloud account is recorded
UpdatedBy.description_zh: 最近修改该策略的操作主体标识。用户策略优先记录操作主体 ID，无操作主体 ID 时记录当前阿里云主账号 UID

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误码；成功时为空

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误信息；成功时为空

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and trace this call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和追踪本次调用

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true：成功；false：失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of policies that meet the query conditions. The value is the sum of the number of all enabled system default policies and the number of user policies of the current account that meet the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的策略总数，为全部启用的系统默认策略数与符合筛选条件的当前账号用户策略数之和
